summary: Monetization supports configuring the transactionSuccess variable in the DataCapture policy to control whether a transaction is monetized.
extended_definition: Monetization supports configuring the transactionSuccess variable in the DataCapture policy to control whether a transaction is monetized.

supporting_pages.title: Managing rate plans for API products \_|\_ Apigee \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Note: A transaction is monetized based on the value of the transactionSuccess monetization variable.
You can get the shared revenue for each monetized transaction by configuring the revShareGrossPrice monetization variable in your DataCapture policy.

Select any one of the following options: Fixed fee per unit (flat fee per unit consumed) Banded (a variable fee per unit consumed, determined by consumption ranges) Stairstep (a single flat fee determined by total consumption) --> Fixed fee per unit: A fixed fee is charged for each monetized transaction.

supporting_pages.title: View message data with the Debug view \_|\_ Apigee \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: In the dialog: Select the Environment in which you want to run the debug session. (Optional) From the Filter list, select a filter to apply to all transactions in the debug session you are creating.
View message data The Debug view in the Apigee Proxy Editor lets you view headers, variables, objects, and other details such as response time in the API proxy request and response flow.
Call the API proxy using curl (or with the URL in a web browser) several times until you see at least one 200 response and one 429 response in the Transactions pane.
